_comment: Record of the powertools-manuals-ka Knowledge Assistant (Agent Bricks). A KA is NOT a Databricks Asset Bundle resource (the bundle only includes resources/*.yml, so this .json is a record, not a deployed resource). It is created/maintained programmatically via the Databricks SDK (w.knowledge_assistants) in etl/src/create_knowledge_assistant.py + etl/src/manage_knowledge_assistant.py — see RUNBOOK.md 'Knowledge Assistant (product manuals)'. On rerun, display_name is unique per workspace: the SDK orchestrator looks the KA up by display_name and REUSES it (attaching/syncing its knowledge source) rather than recreating. Deleting a KA is destructive/irreversible — manual last resort only, never routine.
_provenance_note: The provenance block below reflects the CURRENT FEVM build only (resource_name, endpoint_name, resolved_volume_path are workspace-specific). Running the parameterized SDK script on another workspace will mint a different id — treat these as an example, not a fixed target. Not secrets; fine to commit.
description: Answers questions about Bosch power-tool product manuals (safety, specifications, operation, battery/charging or mains, maintenance, troubleshooting, warranty). RAG over the PDFs in the manuals/ Volume folder.
instructions: Answer only from the retrieved product manuals and always cite the source manual. Identify the specific tool model (e.g. GBH 2-26) the question is about. If a spec or fault code is not in the manuals, say so rather than guessing.

knowledge_source.description: Bosch power-tool operating manuals (PDFs) — safety, specs, operation, battery/mains, maintenance, troubleshooting, warranty.
